info.name: Expense Tracker API
info.description:
REST API for the Expense Tracker backend (prefix `/api/v1`).

**Quick start**
1. Start the app (`./mvnw spring-boot:run`).
2. Run `Auth → Register` (or `Login`). Tokens are saved automatically to collection variables.
3. Run `Categories → List` to capture default category ids, then any other request.

Every request inherits `Bearer {{accessToken}}` from the collection unless marked No Auth.
You can run the whole collection top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner: it is ordered as a full scenario.

Sign-up needs an email code: run Register, put the code from your inbox (or the server log when MAIL_ENABLED=false) into the `otp` collection variable, then run Verify Email. After that, run the other folders in order.

Every response has the same envelope: success, status, message, data (on success), code + fieldErrors (on error), timestamp, path. Scripts read values from `data`.

request.description:
Creates an UNVERIFIED user and emails a 6-digit code. No tokens yet. 409 if the email is already verified; registering again while unverified sends a new code.

Next: copy the code from the email (or from the server log when MAIL_ENABLED=false) into the collection variable `otp`, then run Verify Email.

exec: pm.test("Standard envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql(pm.response.code); pm.expect(b.message).to.be.a("string"); });

request.description: Sends a new code and invalidates the old one. purpose: EMAIL_VERIFICATION (default) or PASSWORD_RESET. Same 200 answer for unknown emails. 429 if asked again within 60 s.

item.name: Password reset
item.description: Forgot password flow: Forgot password → (code by email) → Verify reset OTP → Reset password. Run it on its own, after the Auth folder.
